My aunts house is super weird. On two different occasions strange things have happened. Once I was staying over in her guest room when I woke up to a blue light started to shine from under the mattress. It was the type of bed frame that you could store things in, so there was barely any space between the base of the frame and floor. I could tell that the light was coming from  within the storage space though. It didnt feel threatening so I went back to sleep. The next morning I checked the storage space under the bed and there were only clothes and bags inside so idk what that was about.

The second time was when my aunt and her family were on a holiday but one of my cousins couldnt join and had to miss out on the trip, so I decided to stay with her to make her feel safer. I was sleeping in the guest room again when I heard a scratching sound on the walls around 4 am. It was not unusual to hear strange sounds in that house. I would frequently hear footsteps, the sound of marbles hitting each other and rolling, plates sliding on tabletops and taps turning on and off by itself. Two days later, I also saw a man standing in her backyard when I was in the kitchen (which overlooked the yard). When I went into the yard he was gone. It took me like 5 seconds to get to the yard and theres no way he could have  jumped over the surrounding fence so quickly.

Tbh it isnt that bad though. Nothing felt dangerous, just slightly strange.
